stories.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows halt after $3 billion streak, but ETH, XRP, and Solana funds keep buying
stories.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs snapped a $3 billion inflow streak, CryptoSlate reports. At the same time, ETFs tied to Ethereum, XRP, and Solana kept pulling in net inflows. The split suggests money is rotating within crypto funds, not leaving the asset class.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows are a core gauge of institutional demand, and a pause for bitcoin while altcoin funds keep growing points to a shift in where big money now sits.
whatToWatch: Whether bitcoin ETF flows turn negative or resume
Whether ETH, XRP, and Solana funds keep pace with recent inflows
questions: What is pulling investors toward ETH, XRP, and Solana funds over bitcoin right now?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows snap after $3 billion streak as ETH, XRP and Solana keep buying

stories.title: Bitcoin outperforms stocks and tracks gold as traders eye $75,000 support
stories.summary: Bitcoin has outperformed stocks and started to move more in line with gold, CoinDesk reports. The shift comes after bitcoin's push toward $81,000 failed, per CryptoSlate, which puts the $75,000 level back in focus as a possible support test. Separately, CryptoSlate reports that bitcoin miners now draw meaningful revenue from high-performance computing work, not just mining.
stories.whyItMatters: A closer link to gold could change how investors treat bitcoin as a hedge, and the miner shift toward computing work changes what "bitcoin exposure" means for stock investors.
whatToWatch: Whether bitcoin holds $75,000 if the pullback continues
Whether the gold correlation lasts beyond a short window
How much revenue miners draw from HPC work in coming quarters
questions: Is the gold correlation a durable trend or a short-term coincidence?

sources.title: Bitcoin miners are no longer pure crypto proxies and are morphing into high-performance computing hubs
Bitcoin’s failed $81,000 breakout just put $75,000 back on the table
Bitcoin is outperforming stocks and correlating with gold just when it matters most

stories.title: Fogo halts mainnet after attacker receives 400 million FOGO tokens, 10% of supply
stories.summary: Layer 1 blockchain Fogo halted its mainnet after an attacker received 400 million FOGO tokens, about 10% of the circulating supply, The Block reports. The halt aims to stop further movement of the tokens while the network responds.
stories.whyItMatters: An exploit worth 10% of a token's supply is a serious incident that can hit confidence and price, and it shows the risk that still sits in newer layer 1 networks.
whatToWatch: Fogo's explanation of how the tokens were obtained
Whether mainnet resumes and when
Any exchange action on the affected tokens
questions: How did the attacker obtain the tokens?

stories.title: Tokenized stock transfer volume jumps 415% in a month to $29.5 billion
stories.summary: Monthly transfer volume for tokenized stocks rose 415% to $29.5 billion, Cointelegraph reports. CoinDesk adds that on-chain activity for tokenized assets overall is running well ahead of what headline figures show.
stories.whyItMatters: Fast growth in tokenized stock volume points to real use of blockchain rails for traditional assets, a key test of crypto's use beyond speculation.
whatToWatch: Whether the growth rate holds up next month
Which platforms and issuers drive most of the volume
questions: How much of this volume is genuine investor activity rather than internal transfers?

sources.title: Tokenized stock transfer volume jumps 415% in 30 days to $29.5B
Tokenized assets are busier than the data shows

stories.title: Bitcoin miner IREN still draws 82% of revenue from BTC despite Microsoft AI cloud deal
stories.summary: Bitcoin miner IREN gets 82% of its revenue from bitcoin mining, even after it freed up capacity for a Microsoft AI cloud computing deal, CryptoSlate reports. The figure shows the AI hosting business is still a minority part of IREN's operation.
stories.whyItMatters: IREN's revenue mix shows how bitcoin miners can add AI compute work without giving up mining, which matters for how investors value miner stocks.
whatToWatch: Whether IREN's AI revenue share grows in coming quarters
How the Microsoft partnership scales over time
questions: How much capacity has IREN committed to Microsoft, and for how long?

sources.title: Bitcoin miner IREN still gets 82% of revenue from BTC after clearing room for Microsoft AI cloud

stories.title: SEC reviews automatic filing pathways after wave of exotic crypto ETF proposals
stories.summary: The SEC is reviewing automatic, fast-track filing pathways for ETFs after a flood of exotic crypto and event-linked ETF proposals, CryptoSlate reports. The review suggests regulators want to reconsider how fast novel ETF structures can reach the market.
stories.whyItMatters: Faster or slower ETF approval pathways directly shape which crypto products reach everyday investors, and how soon.
whatToWatch: Any formal rule change the SEC proposes
The outcome for pending exotic crypto ETF filings
questions: Which specific proposals prompted this review?
Will the SEC tighten or loosen the fast-track pathway?

sources.title: The SEC is reviewing automatic filing pathways after exotic crypto and event-linked ETF proposals flooded the market

stories.title: Polygon discloses security flaws already fixed in recent hard forks
stories.summary: Polygon disclosed security flaws that recent hard forks had already fixed, Cointelegraph reports. Details on the specific vulnerabilities remain limited.
stories.whyItMatters: Retroactive disclosure of flaws in a major layer 2 network is a reminder that even established chains can carry undisclosed risk until patched.
whatToWatch: Full technical details on the disclosed flaws
Confirmation on whether any funds were at risk before the fixes
questions: Were any funds exposed before the forks patched these flaws?
Why did disclosure come only now?

stories.title: Stellar's tokenized real-world asset market more than quadruples to nearly $4 billion
stories.summary: The tokenized real-world asset market on Stellar grew to nearly $4 billion, more than four times its prior size, Cointelegraph reports.
stories.whyItMatters: Rapid growth in real-world asset tokenization on Stellar points to rising institutional use of the network for bonds, funds, and other traditional assets.
whatToWatch: Which issuers and asset types drive most of the growth
Whether the growth pace continues
questions: What caused the sudden jump, and how concentrated is it among a few issuers?

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs end 9-day inflow streak as BTC dips below $78,000
stories.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw their nine-day inflow streak end as bitcoin's price fell below $78,000, Cointelegraph reports.
stories.whyItMatters: A break in ETF inflows alongside a price drop is worth watching as a signal of whether institutional demand is cooling.
whatToWatch: Whether outflows continue or inflows resume
Bitcoin's price action near the $75,000 to $78,000 range
questions: Is this outflow tied to broader market conditions or to bitcoin-specific concerns?

stories.whyItMatters: Fed comments on inflation shape rate expectations, and rate expectations directly affect risk appetite for bitcoin and other crypto assets.
whatToWatch: Upcoming Fed statements or rate decisions
Bitcoin's price reaction to new inflation data
questions: Which specific inflation metrics did Warsh cite?

stories.title: Swift's $1.5 quadrillion network faces a blockchain test
stories.summary: Swift, the messaging network behind $1.5 quadrillion in global payment flows, faces a test from blockchain-based alternatives, CoinDesk reports.
stories.whyItMatters: How Swift responds to blockchain competition will shape how fast institutional cross-border payments move onto crypto rails.
whatToWatch: Any pilot programs or partnerships Swift announces
Whether competing blockchain payment networks gain share
questions: Which blockchain systems pose the most direct challenge to Swift?

stories.title: The next trillion-dollar currency may not be a stablecoin, and it may not have a name yet
stories.summary: CoinDesk argues the next currency to reach trillion-dollar scale might not be a stablecoin at all, and could take a form that has no name yet.
stories.whyItMatters: The idea challenges the assumption that stablecoins are the endpoint for digital money, a question worth tracking as the market for digital value evolves.
whatToWatch: Emerging currency models or projects that could fit this description
questions: What form could this currency take if not a stablecoin?
